patch.value: GH-711: update must support intentional unresolved parent references under strict governance

Add create/update parity for an explicit allow-missing-parent escape hatch so strict parent_reference policy can support forward-declared hierarchy construction without disabling validation globally. GitHub: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/711

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Duplicate check: searched every tracker status for GH-711, allow missing parent, strict parent_reference, and update parent parity; no canonical item exists. Related lineage: pm-p9hw established create parent semantics and pm-usfg owns SDK-first mutation parity.

author: harness:claude-code

patch.value: pm update accepts the same allow-missing-parent escape hatch as pm create, with one shared flag spelling and one shared contract entry rather than a second per-command implementation; using it under strict parent_reference governance records a validation warning instead of failing, matching create-side behaviour exactly; omitting it preserves today's strict fail-fast on an unresolved parent; forward-declared hierarchy construction (child created or re-parented before its parent exists) round-trips through create and update without disabling parent validation globally; a parity spec asserts create/update agreement for the flag, its warning payload, and its history record

message: Backfill acceptance criteria, estimate, risk, confidence and flag-parity lineage; verified the asymmetry live (--allow-missing-parent present on create --help, absent on update --help)

author: harness:claude-code
message: Strategic reachability edge: mirror the hierarchy rung into the typed layer so every active item resolves to an outcome milestone through an explainable implements path (pm-bzmeaa invariant), which the parent chain alone cannot express because it terminates at the roadmap root rather than at an outcome
